# Issue #30 Plan

## AC-to-Change Mapping
- AC1 (FetchContent + alias compiles/links) -> add `TiffCraft::TiffCraft` ALIAS + TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL guard so consumed builds don't pull tests/apps/examples.
- AC2 (install + find_package exposes TiffCraft::TiffCraft) -> install(TARGETS/EXPORT), TiffCraftConfig.cmake, TiffCraftConfigVersion.cmake, $<INSTALL_INTERFACE> include dirs.
- AC3 (standalone still builds tests/apps/examples by default) -> option default ON via `CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR` check.
- AC4 (subdirectory consumption doesn't build tests/apps/examples) -> option default OFF in non-top-level scope.
- AC5 (README lists FetchContent and find_package consumption) -> README section.

## Ordered Change List
1. Root /home/daniel/tiffcraft/CMakeLists.txt: add GNUInstallDirs/CMakePackageConfigHelpers includes; alias + include genexes; install/export block; write_basic_package_version_file; install(FILES ...).
2. Guard tests/apps/examples behind TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL.
3. Add generated TiffCraftConfig.cmake (+ install it) and TiffCraftConfigVersion.cmake.
4. Update /home/daniel/tiffcraft/README.md with FetchContent + find_package consumption sections.
5. Add CHANGELOG.md entry under [0.2.0-Unreleased] / Added.

## Risk and Rollback Notes
- Version mismatch (0.1.0 vs 0.2.0) intentionally out of scope (release/version planning).
- If install(EXPORT) has issues, fallback: adjust destinations/genexes; rollback = revert root CMakeLists + README + CHANGELOG.

## Validation Plan
- Commands taken from repository docs: `cmake --preset gcc-linux-release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=...`, `cmake --build --preset gcc-linux-release -j`, `ctest --preset gcc-linux-release --output-on-failure`, `cmake --build --preset gcc-linux-release --target install`.
- Additional local consumer validations: standalone default build (tests/apps/examples present), add_subdirectory consumer (no tests/apps/examples), FetchContent-style consumer via SOURCE_DIR (compiles+links with TiffCraft::TiffCraft), find_package consumer after install.

## Documentation Action Plan
- INLINE: README.md new CMake consumption section; CHANGELOG.md new entry.

Requirements: GATE B plan file must exist and be complete. Write only this file; do not modify the repository.
